referents.why: First person 'I made' inside the LORD's speech: the LORD. Not in this verse's candidate list (see cant_tell).
'Its garment' (third masculine singular): the sea of 38:8, the owner of the clouds as garment. The sea is not offered as a candidate.
referents.category: pronoun for a non-person from an earlier verse

referents.why: 'Its swaddling band' (third masculine singular): the sea, as w5.
referents.category: pronoun for a non-person from an earlier verse

links.why: The infinitive 'made the clouds' is nested in the when-clause. The builder lists this link twice; it is kept once.
The second item 'thick darkness its swaddling band' lies inside the same temporal span.
A separate waw joins two parallel acts of the one LORD: the clouds as garment, the darkness as swaddling band.

none_fit.what: A chain of when-clauses, each setting the time of the enclosing act. No temporal link type covers this.

cant_tell.what: The LORD is not in this verse's candidate list.
cant_tell.why: Chosen from the speech, as in 38:8.
